method: Assistant read transcripts and authored criterion judgments and evidence positions. Python only serializes annotations, calculates scores and validates schema. No deployed model inference for these rows.
limitations: Independent subjective review, not an accuracy measurement or trained-model benchmark.
Assessment uses supplied transcript and checklist; external brokerage product facts were not independently verified.
No audio was listened to; calls judged solely by supplied transcript.
Closing interpreted literally: summary or offer of further help, plus goodbye. A goodbye alone is insufficient.
Evidence positions are 1-based over the full original transcript, including bot and system messages.
